_comment: Region config template for a new U.S. state. Copy this file to regions/<statename>.json (e.g. regions/montana.json), fill in the fields below, then add an entry to regions/_states.json. No code changes required.
description: _comment: One-sentence description of the data sources for this state.

countyBoundarySource._comment: Used by the Data screen (Stage 19) to draw the interactive county download map. Point to a public GeoJSON endpoint returning county polygons for this state. The Census TIGER REST API works for all 50 states — change the STATE filter to your state's 2-digit FIPS code.
countyBoundarySource.attribution: U.S. Census Bureau — TIGER/Line Web Map Service
countyBoundarySource.license: Public Domain — U.S. Government work, 17 U.S.C. § 105

groups._comment: A group is a section in the Layers panel. Each group has a label, description, controlType, and a list of layers.
groups.label: Human-readable group name shown in Layers panel
groups.description: One sentence about what these layers show and their source.

layers._comment: One entry per downloadable or streamable layer. All fields documented below.
layers.name: Short name shown in Layers panel (e.g. Walk-In Areas (WGFD))
layers.description: Plain-English explanation shown under the layer name. Include what it shows, who manages it, and what the user should verify before hunting.
layers._comment_sourceType: Accepted values: geojson | xyz | wmts | shapefile
layers._comment_renderType: Accepted values: fill (polygons) | line (roads/trails/boundaries) | circle (points) | raster (XYZ/WMTS tiles)
layers._comment_downloadUrl: URL for the Stage 19 download manager to fetch. Must be a direct GeoJSON (or MBTiles for rasters) URL. Set to null if the layer is derived from another (dependsOn).
layers.license: License string shown in attribution panel (e.g. Public Domain — State of Montana)
layers._comment_defaultOn: Whether this layer is enabled by default in new projects.
layers._comment_onlineOnly: true = can only stream live (e.g. raster XYZ tile layer). false = requires local download.
layers._comment_downloadable: true = user can download this layer for offline use via the Data screen.
layers._comment_requiresDownload: true = layer cannot render without a local download (e.g. GeoJSON data). false = can stream live.
layers._comment_accessCategory: Set to 1-5 if this layer corresponds to an access category. Null for non-access layers. 0 = access routes.
layers._comment_accessRuleId: ID of the rule in access-rules/<state>.json that classifies this layer. Null for non-access layers.
layers._comment_dependsOn: Layer ID this layer depends on (e.g. label layer depends on boundary layer). Null if independent.

style._comment: Default rendering style. Applied when no user customization is active.
style._comment_strokeDash: Array [dashLen, gapLen] for dashed lines, e.g. [4, 3]. Null for solid lines.
style._comment_pattern: Fill pattern: solid | diagonal-hatch | cross-hatch | dots | none
